//: Config used ONLY by Vercel's @vercel/node when compiling the serverless function entry (api/index.ts). It is discovered before ../tsconfig.json because it sits next to the entry. The main tsconfig scopes rootDir to src/ (for the Replit build), which excludes this api/ file and makes @vercel/node skip emit; here we widen rootDir to the package root and never skip emit on error so the function compiles.
